text: Code reviews are an essential practice in software development, where team members examine each other’s code before it is merged into the main project. The primary benefit is catching bugs early, which saves time and money compared to fixing issues after release. Beyond error detection, code reviews promote knowledge sharing, as developers explain their logic and learn new techniques from colleagues. This process also raises overall team quality by encouraging consistent coding standards and collective ownership of the codebase. When everyone participates respectfully, reviews become a learning tool, not a criticism session, ultimately leading to stronger, more reliable software.
